result.topic_en: Pencil drafts of private letters, not mathematics: one to a family member, apparently for a birthday, reporting that the Habilitationsschrift has been submitted, that Gauss chose the third of three proposed lecture topics (the hypotheses underlying geometry), and asking to come home for 6 to 8 weeks; a second family note begins below it, followed by the start of a formal letter to a professor.
